help.stdout:
Usage:
  clynxer <file.lynx>                          Run a Lynxer source file
  clynxer --no-opt <file.lynx>                 Run without the AST optimizer
  clynxer --lint <file.lynx>                   Check Lynxer syntax without running it
  clynxer --format <file.lynx>                 Rewrite a file with canonical spacing
  clynxer --format-oneline <file.lynx>         Collapse a file onto one physical line
  clynxer --compile <a.lynx> [options] [name]  Compile input files into one executable
  clynxer --bundle <a.lynx> [options] [name]   Alias of --compile
      --include <file>                         Embed a module, native library or data file
      -o, --output <name>                      Name the output executable
  clynxer --validate-executeable               Run the interpreter self-check
  clynxer --version                            Print version
  clynxer --list-stdlibs                       List available Lynxer stdlib modules
  clynxer --install                            Install the executable as /usr/bin/lynxer
  clynxer --uninstall                          Remove /usr/bin/lynxer

Not available in CLynxer (reported as an explicit error):
  --ast

Removed with the bytecode backend (use --compile):
  --view-bytecode, --benchmark-compile, --no-cache
